name: climbing-rope
description: A continuous spiral coil of climbing rope with a complete loose outer end.
useCase: Identify coiled climbing ropes or rope equipment.
misuse: Use a visible label when equipment identifies a product, outdoor activity or required gear.

16.reason: The full continuous coil keeps clear spacing between its turns and loose end.

24.reason: The larger continuous coil retains broad spacing between the full turns and loose outer end.
